reason: The README clearly describes a plugin that monitors agent completion, errors, questions, and approval waits and sends cross-platform desktop notifications, so notifications-monitoring is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 在智能体完成任务、出错、提问或等待审批时发送跨平台桌面通知。
summaries.en: Sends cross-platform desktop notifications when an agent finishes, errors, asks a question, or awaits approval.

capabilities: Monitors agent status, question, and approval events
Sends desktop notifications through platform notification backends
May invoke local notification commands such as notify-send or osascript
